apps.title: Smart Inspector
apps.summary: Multi-modal vision inspection service providing automatic image tagging, captions, object detection, and OCR transcription.
apps.description: Smart Inspector leverages Azure OpenAI Responses API to inspect uploaded images. Built with Pillow-based image validation, EXIF metadata stripping, dimension bounds, and server-enforced rate limits.

apps.title: Support Bot
apps.summary: Healthcare billing support assistant featuring Azure AI Language NLP analysis, PII data masking, and grounded FAQ retrieval.
apps.description: Support Bot connects Azure AI Language (PII detection, sentiment, key phrase extraction) with Azure AI Agents. Includes strict grounding against prompt injection using untrusted input isolation tags.

apps.title: Prompt Forge
apps.summary: Structured content generation workbench with Azure Content Safety filtering, persona tuning, and SSE real-time streaming.
apps.description: Prompt Forge enables marketing teams to generate structured content variations. Integrates Azure Content Safety for pre-generation inspection, streaming SSE responses, and client-side history storage.

apps.title: pocketRag
apps.summary: Private multilingual RAG knowledge base with SQLite vector storage, bundled example documents, and inspectable citations.
apps.description: pocketRag indexes PDF, Markdown, TXT, and DOCX files with Azure OpenAI embeddings and SQLite/NumPy cosine retrieval, then generates grounded answers with inline citations, private access, cost controls, and automatic upload expiry.

apps.title: Agentic Workflow
apps.summary: Autonomous agent execution loop with multi-tool calling, in-memory stateful session lifecycle, and Human-in-the-Loop authorization.
apps.description: Agentic Workflow implements a ReAct loop with deterministic tool calling (calculator, knowledge search, and sensitive alerts). Integrates mandatory Human-in-the-Loop authorization before executing critical actions.

apps.title: Agent Workspace
apps.summary: Streaming AI agent workspace with Foundry Agent Service, typed MCP tools, approval gates, and durable conversations.
apps.description: Agent Workspace connects a Next.js streaming chat to Azure AI Foundry Agent Service and a Node.js MCP server. It includes three typed workspace tools, explicit approval for writes, an offline provider for CI, and Cosmos DB conversation persistence.
